issues.title: sorting options for anime/manga list.
issues.body:
### Feature Summary

Sorting for the list only allows you to sort by last updated, either from greatest to smallest or vice versa. However, we currently lack features to sort alphabetically, by chapters/episodes remaining, unread count, latest chapter update, user score, or even randomly.

### Detailed Description

### Current Behavior
Sorting for the list only allows sorting by last updated, either from greatest to smallest or vice versa. No other sorting options are currently available.
